title: What Is Uterine Prolapse Surgery?
description: What uterine prolapse surgery (prolapse repair) is, what it involves, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It corrects the descent of the uterus and vaginal walls that causes discomfort and urine leakage. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It corrects the descent of the uterus and vaginal walls that causes discomfort and urine leakage.

How is it done?

Vaginal or laparoscopic repair, with or without hysterectomy and with pelvic floor reinforcement.

When is it indicated?

Symptomatic prolapse that affects quality of life and does not improve with conservative measures.
